rule: Only sources with enabled:true AND tos.status:"CLEARED" are ever fetched. CLEARED means the terms and robots.txt were checked and do not prohibit low-rate automated reading. Anything else stays off until Rob rules. robots.txt is re-checked at runtime on every run regardless.

tos_statuses.CLEARED: terms checked; no prohibition on automated access found; robots.txt honored at runtime
tos_statuses.BLOCKED: terms explicitly prohibit scraping/robots, or robots.txt disallows — do not enable
